items.title: Generic procedure signatures: $T type parameters, checked and refused explicitly
items.body:
Parse and check `$T` type parameters on procedure parameters (`swap :: (a: *$T, b: *$T)`, `first :: (v: [] $T) -> $T`) in the Coax parser and checker kernels. Bind each parameter at its first occurrence, check every other use against it, and refuse unsupported forms (a parameter only in the result, nested generic types, `$T` in structs, recursion through a generic) with new explained error codes. No emission yet: a generic procedure that is called reports E-code `generic instantiation not yet supported` at the call, never miscompiles.

## Files

- `coax/lib/compiler/parser.coax`
- `coax/lib/compiler/checker.coax`
- `coax/spec.md`
- `coax/grammar.ebnf`
- `coax/src/errors.cpp`
- `coax/tests/generics.py`

## Acceptance

- Check-first parser/checker #test/#forall cases for binding, mismatch and every refused form; `coax mutate` on parser.coax and checker.coax has zero survivors
- `coax explain` documents each new code; tests/tools.py passes
- spec.md and grammar.ebnf describe the form; existing programs are byte-identical in generated C

items.title: Instantiate generic procedures by specialization key, in the evaluator and native C
items.body:
Each call of a generic procedure resolves a specialization key (resolved argument types, target, arithmetic profile) and gets one checked instance, shared by every call with the same key. Instances are emitted with C names derived from the declaration ID plus the key, and are evaluated identically by #run and checks. Bound the number of instances per program (a deterministic budget with an explained error) and report instance counts, time and generated bytes in `--timings`.

## Files

- `coax/lib/compiler/checker.coax`
- `coax/src/emit_c.cpp`
- `coax/src/eval.cpp`
- `coax/src/main.cpp`
- `coax/tests/generics.py`

## Acceptance

- Fixtures: the same generic called with int, f64 and a struct gives identical results in the evaluator and native C at -O0/-O2 (differential oracle)
- Two calls with one key share one C instance; changing the arithmetic profile changes the key
- An instance-explosion fixture fails with the explained budget code; --timings lists instance counts
- Mutation zero survivors on touched kernels

items.title: Value parameters $N for fixed arrays and generic struct values
items.body:
Add compile-time value parameters (`sum :: (a: [$N] $T) -> $T`) and generic copyable structs (`Pair :: struct($T) { a: $T; b: $T; }`) over fixed storage only: no allocation, no implicit context, borrowed views keep their stated lifetime limits. Layout queries and declaration IDs name each instance.

## Files

- `coax/lib/compiler/parser.coax`
- `coax/lib/compiler/checker.coax`
- `coax/src/emit_c.cpp`
- `coax/src/main.cpp`
- `coax/tests/generics.py`

## Acceptance

- Fixtures for [$N]T sums and Pair($T) values agree between evaluator and C; `coax layout` lists each instance with its size and alignment
- Refused forms (an unbound $N, a generic struct holding a view past its lifetime rule) fail with explained codes
- Mutation zero survivors on touched kernels

items.title: Constraints on type parameters with instantiation traces
items.body:
Let a parameter state what it needs (`$T: Ordered`, built-in constraint names only: numeric, ordered, equatable, copyable) and check bodies against the constraint, not the instance. A failing instantiation reports the use site, the generic declaration and the constraint, as a source-level instantiation trace. No operator overloading in this slice.

## Files

- `coax/lib/compiler/checker.coax`
- `coax/spec.md`
- `coax/tests/generics.py`

## Acceptance

- A body using < on an unconstrained $T is refused at the declaration; a call with a type outside the constraint is refused at the call with a trace naming both
- Constraint checks are in the checker kernel with zero mutation survivors
- spec.md lists the constraint names and their meaning

items.title: Replace a duplicated bounded algorithm with one generic version
items.body:
Pick a real duplicated bounded container or algorithm in the compiler kernels, Verse or the web app (for example insertion sort or bounded search written once per element type) and replace the copies with one generic procedure. Compare outputs, memory and iteration cost before and after, and test rejected constraints and specialization limits on that consumer. Then audit #76ba's acceptance and close it.

## Files

- `coax/tests/generics.py`
- `docs/verification/`

## Acceptance

- The consumer's existing checks pass unchanged and its generated behavior is identical (differential fixtures)
- A retained before/after record of generated C size, peak memory and iteration cost
- #76ba closes only when the four earlier children and this consumer pass
